name: 汽车头枕腰靠六件套款
description: 六件套车内软装靠枕，科学曲度承托颈腰，吸汗透气回弹有力

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless warm off-white #F7F5F1 for packshots, spec and variant screens; deep charcoal #141414 for claim, trust and closing screens; mid charcoal #3A3A3A for pain-point and comparison panels
styleLock.lightingSystem: warm balanced soft diffused key light with soft fill and soft contact shadows, controlled low speculars, no harsh rim flare, consistent direction across the whole set
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte woven fabric texture and matte charcoal board #2B2B2B, plain unbranded seat material #C8B9A6 for in-cabin shots
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines in charcoal #2B2B2B on light panels and warm off-white #F7F5F1 on dark panels
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons and thin round outline labels in one accent #C6A15B only
styleLock.presentationRules: stable contoured-cushion scale and centering, same hero angle family across set, product never clipped and never floating without a contact shadow, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout
noDrift: no branded wordmarks or character artwork
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium automotive-interior soft-goods visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep charcoal #141414, warm off-white #F7F5F1, charcoal text #2B2B2B and one muted gold accent #C6A15B; warm balanced soft diffused lighting with soft fill and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines; consistent thin round outline labels and rounded info panels; consistent thin-line icon style in the single accent #C6A15B; clean high-end soft-goods product photography on seamless backgrounds mixed with minimal dark infographic elements; stable contoured-cushion scale and placement with no visible automotive brand badges or branded wordmarks anywhere; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼看清整套软装，干净合规无文字

shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill, soft contact shadow grounding every piece
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The complete set of matching contoured car cushion pieces arranged as one neat front-row group, straight-on eye-level view, full set visible and not clipped by the frame, the set filling 60-70% of the frame as one complete centered composition. Bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill, soft contact shadow grounding every piece. Seamless background #F7F5F1. 4K, commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no text, no logos, no watermark, no fake logo, no automotive brand badges, no props, no hands, no decorative elements, no cut-off edges, no floating pieces, no colour cast, no gradient background.
